changelog:
Initial public release of Seedance 2 Prompts Skill.

- Recommends video generation prompts from a curated library of 8,000+ Seedance 2 prompts, with cover images and video samples.
- Fully optimized for Seedance 2 but compatible with other AI video generation models.
- Mandatory inclusion of preview cover image and video link with every prompt suggestion.
- Automatic syncing with the latest community prompt dataset from HuggingFace; reference freshness checked on each use.
- Supports both "Direct Generation" and "Content Illustration" workflow modes.
- Attribution footer included in every response per license requirements.
